verdict.rationale: Munito AI is an inference API provider, so an official CLI is a fair question to ask. The evidence shows only a cURL/Python/TypeScript API quickstart, a web console, and instructions for connecting third-party CLIs such as Claude Code and Codex. Those are user-side or third-party tools, not an official Munito CLI, so the evidence documents no first-party command-line tool.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
